lines.text: This is Gerald. Gerald is a turkey.
lines.caption: This is Gerald. Gerald is a turkey.

lines.text: Yesterday was Thanksgiving, so Gerald spent the whole day hiding in a pumpkin.
lines.caption: Yesterday was Thanksgiving, so Gerald spent the whole day hiding in a pumpkin.

lines.text: He survived! Gerald was so happy, he did a little dance.
lines.caption: He survived! Gerald was so happy, he did a little dance.

lines.text: Then he saw the sign: Black Friday. Everything, fifty percent off.
lines.caption: Then he saw the sign: Black Friday. Everything, fifty percent off.

lines.text: Gerald had never been shopping. He grabbed a cart.
lines.caption: Gerald had never been shopping. He grabbed a cart.

lines.text: Turns out, Black Friday crowds are scarier than Thanksgiving.
lines.caption: Turns out, Black Friday crowds are scarier than Thanksgiving.

lines.text: So Gerald is back in the pumpkin. See you next year, Gerald.
lines.caption: So Gerald is back in the pumpkin. See you next year, Gerald.
